hotelUrls.title: Property URLs
hotelUrls.description: Traveloka hotel, villa or apartment page URLs, for example https://www.traveloka.com/id-id/hotel/indonesia/hotel-borobudur-jakarta-7584. The numeric ID at the end of the URL is what matters; the slug is ignored.

hotelIds.title: Property IDs
hotelIds.description: Bare numeric Traveloka property IDs, if you already have them from a previous run.

searchQueries.title: Property name searches
searchQueries.description: Property names to look up, one per line, for building a competitor set. This matches PROPERTY NAMES, not cities: 'Kempinski Jakarta' works, 'hotels in Jakarta' does not. Listing every hotel in a city is not available (see README).

maxPropertiesPerQuery.title: Max properties per search
maxPropertiesPerQuery.description: How many matching properties to keep from each entry in 'Property name searches'.

sitemapSweepLimit.title: Sitemap sweep size
sitemapSweepLimit.description: Collect this many property IDs from Traveloka's public hotel sitemaps for broad market sampling. Leave at 0 to skip. Each sitemap leaf holds 5,000 properties.

sitemapSkipLeaves.title: Sitemap leaves to skip
sitemapSkipLeaves.description: Start the sitemap sweep this many leaf files in, so repeat runs sample different properties instead of the same first page.

maxProperties.title: Max properties per run
maxProperties.description: Hard cap on how many properties this run scrapes, across all input sources.

checkInDate.title: Check-in date
checkInDate.description: Stay date in YYYY-MM-DD, used for the room list and as the first month of the price calendar. Defaults to 30 days from today.

nights.title: Nights
nights.description: Length of stay used when requesting the room list.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult guests priced for. Rates change with occupancy.

calendarMonths.title: Price calendar months
calendarMonths.description: How many consecutive months of nightly rates to pull per property, starting at the check-in month. One request per month; each returns up to 31 nightly prices.

includePriceCalendar.title: Include nightly price calendar
includePriceCalendar.description: Pull nightly rates and the weekday-versus-weekend summary. Turn off for a faster profile-only run.
includePriceCalendar.groupDescription: Each section adds requests per property; switch off what you do not need.

includeRooms.title: Include room inventory
includeRooms.description: Pull room names, photos, bedding, size and amenities. Note that per-room nightly rates are not available (see README); rates come from the price calendar.

includeReviewSummary.title: Include review summary
includeReviewSummary.description: Pull the overall guest rating and review count for each property.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Traveloka locale. This drives the language of facility names, room descriptions and labels.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency for all prices in the output.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to pause between API calls. Raise it if you see repeated 429 or 5xx responses.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Residential is the default: Traveloka's AWS WAF answers a captcha to the session bootstrap on most Apify datacenter IPs. If you pick a datacenter group, the actor tries it first and falls back to residential sessions when it is challenged.
